_readme: Plain-language lines for the web app's What's new popup, keyed by PR number. Every PR merged to main shows up automatically with its title; add a line here to reword it for Tee, or "" to hide a behind-the-scenes change.
85: Shadows are cheaper to draw, so the tank runs smoother on High
84: Nassarius snails crawl at their real slow speed, and the banded shrimp roams more
83: Buttons no longer cover each other on small screens, and a softer sand edge at the front glass
82: Fish swim smoothly: no more flips, pops or teleporting
81: Smarter fish: they notice things, remember feeding time, have moods and their own quirks
80: Submarine mode: drive a little toy sub around the fish
79: More finger tricks on the tank, and a nori clip that sways in the flow
78: Thinking readout: tap an animal to see what it is planning and feeling
77: The supply shelf has real room lighting, soft shadows and wood grain
75: Better pajama cardinal, coral banded shrimp and skunk shrimp
74: Hermit crabs rebuilt: they really walk, pick with their claws and hide in their shells
73: Every shelf item now does its own thing in the tank
72: Fish look clean up close, with no white net or pale outline
71: Screensaver mode: a movie-style camera that glides around the tank
68: Tap the glass, sand or rock and the animals come to look
66: Supply shelf items look like the real products
65: Faster drawing, so the tank runs smoother
64: Calmer tank sounds: a soft water hum instead of hiss
62: Care and dosing items on the shelf work in Watch mode too
63: The browser version has the full sandbox, just like the Android app
60: The rockwork always loads now, even on a slow connection
